data.body: Correction to the task-116 completion memo: it claimed "this codebase has no BudgetLedgerV1", which is wrong. crates/aworkit-workflow-worker/src/limits.rs implements Budget/Usage/BudgetEnvelope/LimitLedger/LimitController, and pipeline.rs builds a LimitLedger for every run. What is missing is not the ledger but any non-sentinel ceiling in it: the desktop freezes tokens and cost to MAX_SAFE_WIRE_INTEGER and deadline (budget.deadline_ms and deadline_epoch_millis) to NO_AGGREGATE_RUN_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MILLIS, with comments stating there is no aggregate run deadline and that usage is reported without a ceiling. The small figures (turns/attempts/actions = 1, depth/fanout/parallel) describe one outer brokered execution and its delegation shape; agent-internal provider calls are explicitly not turn-capped (legacy_maximum_turns: None). The frozen run_deadline_millis is inert legacy data. Practical conclusion stands (nothing cumulative caps a run), but the reason was wrong.
